comment: Each entry is a (scenario, op?, language) expected to FAIL today. CI asserts the observed failure set equals exactly this set. When a fix lands, delete its entry here so CI flips green. See conformance/README.md.

gaps.note: Bindings skip TTL when ttl<=0 (`if t > 0`) and return true; core rejects as Invalid. Fix: convert + pass through, let the core validate.
kv_get runs bytes through from_utf8_lossy → U+FFFD. Fix: raise Invalid on non-UTF-8 and/or add kvGetBytes/kv_get_bytes returning Buffer/bytes.
Node JsDecision omits reset_after_seconds, so a Node app cannot emit the IETF RateLimit-Reset header. Fix: add resetAfterSeconds to the Node decision.
Python schedule_at takes epoch SECONDS while Node takes ms; canonical is ms. Fix: switch Python schedule_at to milliseconds.
Config keys are global per database; the namespace only covers kv/ratelimit/blob today. Fix: namespace config keys so apps sharing a database are isolated.
Queue names are global per database. Fix: prefix queue names with the namespace.
Python clamps visibility to .max(0.001) so 0 becomes a 1ms lease instead of the core's Invalid. Fix: convert + pass through, let the core validate.
Both bindings return only {id, secret} from create_api_key, dropping label + created_at. Fix: return the full key metadata (Node object / Python class).
Sessions are global per database; a session from one app validates in another. Fix: add an app/namespace column scoping sessions (and api keys).
